name: sweep-objects
title: Sweep objects together
description: Push several objects on one support toward their centroid until they form a cluster (radius 12 cm), without grasping them.
use_when: Several small objects on one support must be gathered into a cluster.

not_to_be_confused_with.arrange: arrange picks and places; sweep only pushes.
not_to_be_confused_with.collect: collect puts objects into a container.

postconditions.meaning: Every listed object's footprint centre lies within the radius of the group centroid, on one support.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

arg_formats.object_list: a non-empty list of object refs

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
